Primary request: one elegant overall architecture diagram of EvoTrace, centered on a TREE-STRUCTURED POPULATION combining retained candidate algorithms, developmental trajectories, and distilled experience.
Layout: upper row left-to-right has four stages. Left a large "Tree-structured population" panel containing a small branching tree of teal candidate circles, one hollow virtual root, and a few orange experience capsules located ON nodes (S) and ON edges (V). Next "Parent + operator" panel (quality and direct-use weighting) with three small choices labelled "Refine", "Crossover", "Explore". Next "Generate & evaluate" panel with a simple code card and evaluation feedback, no invented numeric scores. Next "Attach evaluated version" panel with a new leaf being attached to a candidate tree.
A clearly connected lower feedback route runs from the attachment stage through a wide module titled "Reflective simplification", then returns to the left population panel. Within this lower module show these three exact substeps left to right: "Choose retained algorithms" -> "Prune branches / contract paths" -> "Distill regional experience". The return route explicitly carries "Retained algorithms + experience". A secondary thin orange connector from the population's attached experiences into the operator/generation stage is labelled "Task-specific tree context"; it carries evidence into the next design decision. This is a single iterative search, not three separate agents.
At the bottom of the maintenance module show two short conditional-rule badges: "V1: capacity-triggered" and "V2: usage + quality". Show the actual value proposition through the diagram: algorithms remain development starting points; removed developmental evidence is converted into located experience rather than discarded. Use only these process labels plus a tiny legend "S: branch experience" and "V: path experience".
Prioritize the central tree and the lower reflection feedback route visually. Keep a clean hierarchy, avoid spaghetti arrows.

Primary request: explain EvoTrace V1's exact joint selection and structural closure with a clear three-panel mechanism schematic, not an empirical results chart.
Panel (a), "Grow": show a stylized pool/tree of candidates under a badge "Trigger: n >= 64". The drawn tree is schematic; do not draw 64 nodes. New leaves are attached between maintenance events.
Panel (b), "Select + close": a precise vertical sequence of three selection rows: "Champion", "Up to 2 young Explore representatives", and "Quality x diversity". An adjacent small branching tree shows that choosing candidate nodes also retains needed branching ancestors and the initial root. Label those extra nodes "Structural anchors". An enclosing capacity bracket says "Candidates + anchors <= 32". A subtle loop arrow from structural anchors to the next candidate selection says "Anchors enter distance comparison". This specific feedback is essential and must be clear. A small label below says "Rank quality >= 0.30". Do not suggest quality selection finishes before adding anchors in V1.
Panel (c), "Simplify": show the resulting compact retained tree, with orange path-experience capsules on contracted edges and orange branch-experience capsules on anchor nodes. Label "Keep <= 32 algorithms". Keep the three stages joined by simple arrows.
A short bottom note: "32 is the post-update limit; growth continues between updates".
Legend: filled teal circles = selected candidates; hollow teal rings = structural anchors; gray dashed circles = removed candidates; orange capsules = distilled experience. Use no invented fitness values or measured node counts.

Primary request: an exact, easily inspectable diagram of EvoTrace V2's single snapshot retention followed by LCA closure. Use the following toy topology exactly, with distinct letters and no extra nodes: virtual root r -> A; A -> B and C; B -> D and E; C -> F and G; G -> H. Arrows point from ancestor to descendant. All letters A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H occur exactly once in the original tree.
Wide three-zone layout. Left "One pre-update snapshot" shows that original tree. Middle has TWO parallel rule boxes: "Recent valid nodes" with the exact condition "t - last_used < 40" and a short set "D, H"; "Quality + diversity representatives" with "rank quality >= 0.50" and a short set "A, F". These independent boxes merge through a union symbol into "Selected: A, D, F, H". Then one separate step "Add required LCA: C". This order is essential: choose once, then structural closure, never repeat ranking within the same maintenance.
Right "Retained tree" shows exactly these connections: r -> A; A -> D and C; C -> F and H. Only nodes r,A,C,D,F,H appear on the right. C is a hollow teal ring labelled "LCA". A,D,F,H are filled teal. The A->D and C->H connections represent contracted paths and can use a small orange V experience badge. Removed B,E,G are NOT present in the right tree.
Bottom short statement "Select once; then close and simplify" and "No fixed population capacity".
This is an illustrative set example, not experimental data. Avoid numerical fitness, node scores, or additional selection heuristics. Keep lettering and the exact parent-child relations legible.

Primary request: a scientifically exact before-and-after diagram of simultaneous path contraction and side-branch pruning, showing where old and new experience goes.
Use a very simple original subgraph: a horizontal chain A -> B -> C -> D, and a branch B -> X downward. A and D are retained teal circles. B, C, X are removed hollow gray circles. Attach a small orange capsule "old S_B" to B; attach a capsule "old S_A" to A. The source of X is B, never A.
In the right "After" panel show only retained nodes A -> D, connected by a direct edge. Attach orange capsule "V_AD" to that edge and orange capsule "S_A" to node A. The removed X must not appear as a retained node in the after panel.
The middle transfer explanation has TWO clearly separated channels with arrowheads: upper "Path: B, C + old S_B" goes to V_AD on the edge A->D; lower "Branch: X + old S_A" goes to S_A attached to A. This precise separation is crucial. Old S_B travels with removed intermediate B into edge experience; the newly removed X goes to the nearest retained ancestor A, not to B and not to edge V_AD.
Use panel labels "(a) Original region", "(b) Unique partition", "(c) Retained structure + experience". Indicate each removed node enters one region exactly once. The main visual point is two complementary transformations executed from one retained set: "Path contraction" and "Branch pruning". Bottom legend: "V: path experience" and "S: branch experience". No counts, fitness, real-world examples, or unnecessary words. White background and well-separated routes.

An internal orange V note is explicitly labelled "V2" with a small marker so this extended input is not falsely attributed to V1. A small code card "One existing code". Lower action label "Rethink the main computation".
Each panel flows into a single small output card "analysis -> code -> design". This depicts alternative operator choices, not parallel agents or three simultaneous generation calls.
A single unobtrusive footer: "One sampled operator; evidence follows the tree position". English text only; no experimental data, no scores.

Primary request: a two-panel diagram explaining actual-use retention and disjoint historical effort in EvoTrace V2. Sparse text, clear semantics.
Panel (a), "Evaluation clock": show a teal candidate circle with a small blue marker "last_used". Three simple incoming events "Birth", "Parent use", "Reference use" refresh that marker. A horizontal evaluation timeline has one band labelled "Recent: t - last_used < 40"; beyond its boundary the label is "Cold". Add a small precise line "Failed and repair evaluations advance t". Add "Reflection does not refresh last_used". Do not use wall-clock hours or imply that every node gets 40 development trials.
Panel (b), "Two roles for recorded effort": show a retained current algorithm with its own teal ledger "Direct children count", an arrow from this ledger to a blue box "Parent sampling: 1 / (1 + direct children)". Separately, show removed path/branch evidence in light gray entering orange "Edge history" and "Node history" capsules; both feed a box "Regional reflection evidence". Under these orange ledgers list the five fields, once each and spelled exactly: "Versions", "Evaluations", "Failures", "Parent uses", "Reference uses". An orange note from reflection is attached back to the retained tree as experience.
A short bottom line says "History is aggregated; direct-use counts keep their meaning". Visually keep the orange historical ledger away from the parent-sampling input: absorbed historical parent uses are not added to the current algorithm's direct children count. Each historical block has only one destination, edge or node; no duplicated evidence, no invented numerical examples.
Use clean thin arrows, ample whitespace, white background and the shared conference-figure style.
